chunks: O believers, when you meet unbelievers on the field of battle, do not turn your backs to them.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command believers to do when meeting disbelievers in battle?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Battle of Badr, emphasizing that steadfastness is not merely physical but requires spiritual resolve against the 'back-turning' of the soul. It establishes the principle of courage and resolve in military engagement for the Muslim community, serving as a foundational text for understanding jihad as a disciplined, collective duty rather than individual heroism.
